title: Miami Events This Week: Sept 28 to Oct 3
igCaption:
Everything happening in Miami this week 🎟️ Free stuff first.

Mon: Bingo After Dark, Fort Lauderdale Improv (free with RSVP)
Tue: Buena Vista Social Club opens at the Arsht ($52+)
Wed: Of Monsters and Men at the Fillmore
Thu: Diego Torres at the Fillmore + Karol G's Carolina pop-up dinner at Casadonna ($150)
Fri–Sat: Karol G's Viajando Por El Mundo pop-up, 555 NW 29th St

Save this and tag who you're going with.

#MiamiEvents #MiamiThisWeek #MiamiThingsToDo #SouthFloridaEvents

scenes.text: Here's everything happening in Miami this week. And we're starting with the free stuff.
Monday night, it's free. Bingo After Dark at the Fort Lauderdale Improv in Dania Beach. It starts at seven. Just RSVP.
scenes.caption: Monday, Sept. 28: Bingo After Dark: Uncensored is at 7 p.m. at Ft. Lauderdale Improv in Dania Beach. Oronde Gadsden and Efendee Studio host the adult-humor bingo night, and admission is free with RSVP.

scenes.text: Tuesday, Buena Vista Social Club opens at the Arsht Center. It's the Tony-winning musical. Tickets start at fifty-two dollars.
scenes.caption: Tuesday, Sept. 29: Buena Vista Social Club opens at the Adrienne Arsht Center at 7:30 p.m. as part of the Broadway in Miami series. The Tony- and Grammy-winning musical follows Omara Portuondo, and tickets cost $52 to $228.

scenes.text: Wednesday, Of Monsters and Men play the Fillmore on Miami Beach. Then on Thursday, Diego Torres takes the same stage.
scenes.caption: Wednesday, Sept. 30: Of Monsters and Men play the Fillmore Miami Beach at 8 p.m. Tickets cost $58.50. Thursday, Diego Torres brings his Mi Norte & Mi Sur Tour there. Tickets cost $52 to $86.

scenes.text: Thursday night, Karol G's restaurant from Medellín pops up at Casadonna. It's a one-night dinner. A hundred and fifty dollars a person.
scenes.caption: Thursday, Oct. 1: Karol G's Medellín restaurant Carolina brings Territorios to Casadonna at 1737 N. Bayshore Drive. Chef Emilio Valencia leads the menu with Chef Lisbeth Mora and Casadonna's team. Seatings run from 6 p.m. to 10 p.m., and dinner costs $150 per person.

scenes.text: Friday and Saturday, Karol G's pop-up opens in Wynwood. Exclusive merch, photo spots, and it's first come, first served.
scenes.caption: Friday and Saturday, Oct. 2 and 3: Karol G's Viajando Por El Mundo pop-up runs from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. at 555 NW 29th Street. It includes interactive stops, custom stamps, exclusive merchandise, and first-come, first-served entry.
